title: Causal Dioramas: Controllable Video Generation, Revision and Editing via Intervention
abstract: arXiv:2611.28098v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Two centuries ago, an early cinema-like theater called the Diorama could already control its scenes at will. Today's video generation models produce videos of near-cinematic quality, yet they still lack this controllability. This limitation stems from the inherent semantic gap between text and pixels, since a prompt can describe a video only coarsely and leaves its details and relations beyond control. We bring this ability to video generation with Causal Dioramas, modules that decompose a video into a concept graph of variables that can be intervened on individually. Each instruction is translated into an intervention on the concept graph, modifying the specified concepts and their dependents. A connector then conveys this intervention to the video generator, which reuses the original noise to produce a counterfactual video while preserving all other content. translated_title: 因果透视模型：基于干预的可控视频生成、修改与编辑
translated_abstract: 两个世纪前，一种被称为“透视画馆”的早期类影院剧场已经能够随意控制其场景。如今的视频生成模型能够生成接近电影质量的视频，但仍然缺乏这种可控性。这一局限源于文本与像素之间固有的语义鸿沟，因为提示词只能粗略地描述视频，使其细节和关系无法被控制。我们通过因果透视模型为视频生成带来了这种能力，该模块将视频分解为由可单独干预的变量组成的概念图。每条指令被转换为对概念图的一次干预，修改所指定的概念及其依赖的内容。随后，一个连接器将该干预传递给视频生成器，生成器复用原始噪声生成反事实视频，同时保留所有其他内容。基于因果透视模型，我们开发了一个统一的可控……框架（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出“因果透视模型”，将视频分解为可单独干预的变量概念图，通过将指令转化为对概念图的干预并复用原始噪声生成反事实视频，实现对视频的可控生成、修改与编辑，同时保留其余内容。
en_tdlr: Causal Dioramas decompose videos into an intervenable concept graph, enabling controllable video generation, revision, and editing by translating instructions into interventions that modify specified concepts while reusing original noise to produce counterfactual videos that preserve all other content.
